2026-11-18 (a8ed5cb): JWT Monitor loaded unmodified in the sidecar with no unsupported call after stages 1-2 (extension, burpSuite, logging, http). It needs its suite tab shown to be usable (stage 3).
resolution: For the four BApps installed locally the answer is settled by running them unmodified: JWT Monitor, JWT4B and JWT Editor work and the MCP Server loads with no unsupported call (a2f0eec; docs/MONTOYA-COVERAGE.md lists every MontoyaApi accessor's state). Calls that were hit and had to be added along the way: MontoyaObjectFactory.highlightColor (JWT4B), UserInterface.registerWebSocketMessageEditorProvider (JWT Editor), a JTabbedPane parent for suite tabs (JWT4B). A wider sample of BApps is tracked as task R-20, not as an open question.
